DIAGNOSIS READY: Osgood-Schlatter disease.

The patient is a 23-year-old female presenting with acute, worsening knee pain localized to the tibial tubercle following recent repetitive pivoting and twisting during volleyball. This presentation is consistent with traction apophysitis of the tibial tubercle, often exacerbated by prior advice regarding weight loss and physical activity.
